raw_segments.text: My boy, my own boy, is among them. For God's sake, I beg, I conjure. Here exclaimed the
stranger captain to Ahab, who thus far had but icily received his petition.
For eight and forty hours let me charter your ship. I will gladly pay for it and roundly
pay for it. If there be no other way, for eight and forty hours only, only that, you
must, oh, you must, and you shall do this thing."
